name: jev-cc-model-router
description: Picks the model once per session and the effort every turn, using TypeSafe's Jev to judge how hard the task is.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Key for Jev (console.typesafe.ai). Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. Without a key the router does nothing.

default_mode.title: Default mode
default_mode.description: shadow: judge and show, never rewrite. auto: rewrite model and effort. off: do nothing. /jcmr changes the current session only.

low_model.title: Low tier model
low_model.description: Default: haiku (a session whose first prompt picks it stays on it). Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable (opus[1m] for 1M context), or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

balanced_model.title: Balanced tier model
balanced_model.description: Default: sonnet. Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable (opus[1m] for 1M context), or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

strong_model.title: Strong tier model
strong_model.description: Default: opus. Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable (opus[1m] for 1M context), or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

long_model.title: Long tier model
long_model.description: Default: fable. For agent sessions that run for hours and deep research, as Anthropic's model selection matrix places Claude Fable 5.1. Switching to it skips Claude Code's confirmation for models billed to usage credits. Type another alias or a full model id, or off to disable the tier.

tier_upgrade_probability.title: Probability to move to a stronger model
tier_upgrade_probability.description: Default: 0.5. On a session's first turn, the model moves to a stronger tier's only when Jev gives at least this probability that the task needs that tier or a stronger one.

tier_min_probability.title: Probability to move to a weaker model
tier_min_probability.description: Default: 0.8. On a session's first turn, the model moves to a weaker tier's only when Jev gives at least this probability that the task needs that tier or a weaker one.

signal_threshold.title: Signal threshold
signal_threshold.description: Default: 0.7. Probability above which a complaint about the last attempt, or a high-stakes task, counts.

continuation_threshold.title: Continuation threshold
continuation_threshold.description: Default: 0.6. Probability above which a prompt counts as continuing the last task, so it keeps the last effort. Lower keeps the effort more often, also for some new tasks.

min_effort.title: Minimum effort
min_effort.description: The lowest effort the router will set.

max_effort.title: Maximum effort
max_effort.description: Default: max. The highest effort the router will set. It applies last, so it wins over the minimum effort and over the high-stakes rule. An effort you set yourself is not capped.

jev_model.title: Jev model
jev_model.description: Default: jev-latest, which follows TypeSafe's newest model; a version such as jev-1.13.0 pins one. The thresholds were tuned on jev-1.13.0.

jev_timeout_seconds.title: Jev timeout (seconds)
jev_timeout_seconds.description: Default: 3. How long a request whose model or effort Jev's answer can change waits for it before going ahead without it. A request it cannot change, as in shadow, goes at once, and only a reply quicker than Jev waits. 0.5 to 8: Jev answers in well under a second, and every second waited delays the reply.

send_assistant_tail.title: Send the end of Claude's last reply
send_assistant_tail.description: Default: off. Recommended: on. Also send the last ~1000 characters of Claude's previous reply to Jev, so a prompt that answers it, or pastes the output it asked for, is judged against it. Off, Jev sees only your prompts and misses far more continuations.

assistant_tail_chars.title: Characters of Claude's reply to send
assistant_tail_chars.description: Default: 1000. How many characters from the end of Claude's last reply go to Jev when send_assistant_tail is on, 100 to 8000. 1000 characters cost about 700 more tokens per prompt, and a longer request makes Jev slower to answer.

fork_follows_route.title: Route forked subagents too
fork_follows_route.description: Default: off. In auto, a subagent forked from the main conversation (one that shares its context) runs on the model the session is routed to rather than the menu model, so it reads the conversation's prompt cache. Its effort is left as it is.
